strength.title: Talent 1

talent_notes.note: Good Juju pure damage per second decreased from 50 + 2%/3%/4% to 50 + 1.5%/2.5%/3.5% of max health

strength.talent_text: Removes all abilities. New Passive Ability: Good Juju Using items triggers, after 0.5s, an area under the hero that deals Pure Damage per second to enemies: 50 + 1.5%/2.5%/3.5% of Max Health Radius: 300 Duration: 4s Does not work on toggleable items.

agility.title: Talent 1

talent_notes.note: Can no longer be learned together with «Talent 4» from the Intelligence branch

agility.talent_text: You cannot attack. Frost Shield becomes a Passive Ability on the Hero. The damage dealt speed is affected by the Attack Speed. Adds 1 Level to Frost Shield.

intelligence.title: Talent 4

talent_notes.note: Can no longer be learned together with «Talent 1» from the Agility branch

intelligence.talent_text: Removes Frost Shield. New Active Ability: Frost Blast Ring Casts Frost Blast after a short delay in a circle around the hero. Radius: 500 Cooldown: 7 seconds Mana Cost: 140

strength.title: Talent 1

talent_notes.note: Activated Headshot cooldown increased from 3s to 6s

strength.talent_text:
Headshot can be activated.

The hero fires a shotgun in a cone-shaped area, performing 1 attack on all affected targets. Guarantees Headshot on enemies. After firing, the hero becomes disarmed for 3 seconds. Silence duration is reduced by status resistance.

Shot Range: 450
Cooldown: 6 sec.

strength.title: Talent 2

talent_notes.note: Headshot damage bonus decreased from 30/60/90 to 0/30/60

strength.talent_text: Maximum attack speed is 150. Headshot Damage Bonus: 0/30/60 + 1.5 per Strength

intelligence.title: Talent 2

talent_notes.note: Concussive Grenade damage increased from 50 + 50%/75%/100% to 50 + 50%/100%/150% of attack damage

intelligence.talent_text: Grenade. Removes Take Aim. New Active Ability: Concussive Grenade The hero throws a grenade into the target area, propelling himself in the opposite direction. Deals magic damage to enemies, knocks them back from the explosion center, silences them, and slows their movement. Damage: 50 + 50%/100%/150% of Attack Damage Radius: 375 Movement Slow: 50% Duration: 2 sec. Knockback Distance: 475 Mana Cost: 50 Cooldown: 20 sec.
